title: Train a Tiny AI on Your iMessages, 100% Local on Mac
description:
So someone built a transformer that learns to text exactly like you 😅

It's called texts to transformer, and it's basically a tiny language model you train from scratch on your own iMessage history. The whole thing run locally on your Mac through Apple MLX, so no cloud no data leaving your machine, nothing. It takes a snapshot of your message database, strips out your personal info, trains it's own tokenizer and then trains the model, and drops you right into a chat inside your terminal.

The wild part is you end up with a personal AI that actually knows how you talk 🔥 and its completely free. Search GitHub for Doriandarko texts to transformer if you wanna try it ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
